_doc: Target bands for the balance table (internal/game/balance.go): weapon -> "part/armor/dist" (head|body|legs / none|vest|helmet / 5|15|30 m) -> shots [min, max] and/or ttkMs [min, max]. CS2 archetypes; TestBalanceBands fails when the data leaves a band. Every weapon needs bands.

head/none/30.why: USP: an unarmored head is one tap at any range

head/helmet/5.why: USP: no one-tap through a helmet

body/none/15.why: USP: 3 up close, falloff makes it 4 at range

head/helmet/5.why: AK: one tap through a helmet

head/helmet/30.why: AK: one tap through a helmet at range too

head/helmet/5.why: M4A1-S: one tap through a helmet up close

body/helmet/5.why: AWP: one shot to the body, armored
